# Retrieval: Search Before Generation {#sec-retrieval}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- build a BM25 baseline and know why it is still hard to beat;
- train and evaluate a dense retriever, including hard-negative mining;
- tune the recall/latency dial on an ANN index deliberately;
- report retrieval quality with recall@k and nDCG instead of eyeballing results.

## Exercises

1. Build BM25 and a dense retriever on the same corpus. Find three queries where each beats the other and explain the pattern.
2. Sweep your ANN index's search parameter. Plot recall@10 against p95 latency and pick an operating point with a stated SLO.
